summary: Turn a line of text into useful pieces.
documentation: split returns substrings separated by a chosen separator. Without sep, runs of whitespace are treated as one separator and leading or trailing whitespace is ignored.
inputs: A string; optional separator and maximum number of splits.
caution: An explicit separator preserves empty fields, while the default whitespace mode does not.
scenarios: Read space-separated labels from pasted text.
Break a log line into fields when its format is simple.
Parse a simple delimiter-separated input; use the csv module for quoted CSV.
title: Read the service tags
problem: Given a string of tags separated by whitespace, return the tags as a list. Ignore extra whitespace and preserve spelling and order.
goal: Use str.split() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Call split without an explicit separator.
